tokens.npc_dota_hero_skeleton_king_bio: For untold years, King Ostarion built a kingdom from the remains of his enemies. It was an obsessive's errand, done to pass the long eternities of a monarchy that seemed fated never to end. He believed that as long as he built up the towers of his palace, he could not die. But eventually he learned that he had been deluded... that bone itself could perish. Deeply mistrustful of flesh, he sought a more permanent way of extending his reign, and at last settled on pursuit of wraith energy, a form of pure spirit given off by certain dark souls at death. Should he infuse himself with Wraith Essence, he thought he might create a body as luminous and eternal as his ego. On the millennial solstice known as Wraith-Night, he submitted to a rite of transformation, compelling his subjects to harvest enough souls to fuel his ambition for immortality. No one knows how many of his champions died, for the only survivor who mattered was the Wraith King who rose with the sun on the following morn. Now he rarely spends a moment on his glowing throne--but strides out with sword drawn, demanding a fealty that extends far beyond death.
tokens.npc_dota_hero_skeleton_king_hype: Striding fearlessly toward his enemies, Wraith King stuns his foes and slashes them into submission. Should his enemies gain the upper hand, his self-resurrecting ultimate ensures he'll have another chance to swing his sword.

fields.name: desc0
fields.value:
Delays the death of Wraith King when killed.

The King enters Wraith Form, granting himself bonus attack speed and bonus movement speed, with unobstructed movement, for a short duration.

The current Wraith duration is then subtracted from the total respawn time once the King dies.

fields.name: desc1
fields.value: Grants Wraith King and his Skeleton Warriors' attacks lifesteal.

fields.name: desc2
fields.value: Lifesteal is less effective when attacking creeps.

fields.name: desc3
fields.value:
The higher the King's level, the greater the lifesteal value.

The Wraith duration and respawn time reduction value scales accordingly per hero level interval.

fields.name: desc4
fields.value:
The Reincarnation active component is inactive during Wraith Form.

The cooldown can neither be reset, nor it is affected by percentage-based cooldown reductions.

fields.name: desc5
fields.value:
Becomes an aura affecting allied heroes within the radius, transforming them into wraiths, and delaying their death.

Allied heroes who die with the Wraith Form aura applied to them have a quicker respawn time.

* {{Symbol|Affect|Enemy}}

*** [[File:Dota2 Wraith King Skeleton Guard Symbol icon.png|21px|link=Wraith King Skeleton]]

**# The first {{M|magical}} {{M|spell damage}}.
**# Both the {{M|stun}} and the {{M|movement speed}} slow debuff at the same time.
**#* {{Symbol|Modifier|Debuff}} {{Code|skeleton_king_hellfire_blast}}

**#** Reapplying the debuff refreshes its duration, and neither updates the ability values nor affects the damage intervals.

* {{cf|talnotes}}
** The {{ValueColor||duration increasing|10tal}} {{M|talent|t=t1l}} increases both the slow duration and the damage over time duration.
** {{Symbol|bonus t4l}} Upon {{A|Wraith King|Reincarnation}} proc, Wraithfire Blast now passively targets enemy heroes within {{ValueColor||{{#var:Wraithfire Blast type1 value1 tal}}|25tal}} radius.
*** Has a {{ValueColor||{{#var:Wraithfire Blast type1 value2 tal}}|25tal}}-{{M|projectile speed}}.

***** {{M|Invisible}} units.
*** Has the following properties upon proc:
**** Replaces both the {{M|movement speed}} slow and {{M|attack speed}} slow components applied.
**** Works independently of Wraithfire Blast's {{M|cooldown}}, and does not cost {{M|mana}}.
**** Does not proc {{M|on-cast effects}}.

fields.value: Conspirators against the Wraith King wonder why he never stays dead.

fields.name: desc0
fields.value:
The Wraith King reforms after death, allowing him to resurrect when killed in battle.

Applies a movement speed slow and an attack speed slow upon death to enemy heroes within the radius when off-cooldown.

fields.name: desc1
fields.value: Self-casting this ability instantly kills the Wraith King.

fields.name: desc2
fields.value: Upon a Reincarnation proc, the King summons Skeletons corresponding to the amount of enemy heroes within the radius.

fields.name: desc3
fields.value: Wraithfire Blast of the corresponding level fully replaces the slow component upon a Reincarnation proc, with a slower projectile speed when off-cooldown.

fields.name: mechanics
fields.value:
{{Reincard}}

* The ability has four components:
** [[File:Dota2 Condition-1.png|1|21px]]
*** The passive component has the following properties:
**** Does not count as an ability cast.
**** Requires at least {{#var:Reincarnation mp}} {{M|current mana}} to activate.
** [[File:Dota2 Condition-2.png|2|21px]]
*** The active component has the following properties:
**** [[Min health]] sources have precedence over the active component cast.
**** {{M|Doubletap}} activates the ability.
***** However, when Wraith King is affected by {{M|invulnerable}} sources, he is unable to cast abilities on himself; hence he is unable to utilize doubletap to self-cast.
*** {{Symbol|Affect|Self}}
**** The active cast ability effects are applied as follows:
****# Reduces Wraith King's {{M|mana}} accordingly to the mana cost.
****#* {{Symbol|Affect|Enemy}} {{to}} {{Symbol|Affect|Self}}
****#** Offensive ability components that apply prior to the ability cast may kill Wraith King upon the active Reincarnation cast.
****#** This causes the following {{M|mana restore}} component to not proc, and indirectly causes {{A|Wraith King|Reincarnation}} to not proc due to not having enough {{M|current mana}}.
****# Self-{{M|instant kills}}.
****# Self-{{M|mana restore|text=mana restores}} based on the ability's mana cost.
****# Procs the ability's passive component.
** [[File:Dota2 Condition-3.png|3|21px]] {{Symbol|Aura}}
*** {{to}} {{Symbol|Affect|Self}}
**** {{M|Reincarnates}} and grants the following bonuses upon activation:
***** 100% max {{M|health}} and max {{M|mana}}.
****** Does not reset ability {{M|cooldowns}}.
***** Grants a {{#var:Reincarnation value2}}-second {{M|daytime}} and {{M|nighttime}} {{M|vision}} bonus based on Wraith King's current vision values at his {{M|death}} location.
*** {{to}} {{Symbol|Affect|Enemy}}
**** {{Symbol|Modifier|Debuff}} {{Code|skeleton_king_reincarnate_slow}}
***** Applies both the {{M|movement speed}} slow and {{M|attack speed}} slow.
***** {{cf|talnotes}} The {{ValueColor||Wraithfire Blast cast|25tal}} {{M|talent|t=t4l}} replaces the slow component with {{A|Wraith King|Wraithfire Blast}} of its corresponding level.
****** Affects the following units:
******* {{M|Fogged units}}.
******* {{M|Invisible}} units.
** [[File:Dota2 Condition-4.png|4|21px]]
*** Summons {{U|Wraith King Skeleton|text=Wraith King Skeletons}} corresponding to {{A|Wraith King|Bone Guard}}'s current level, per affected enemy hero within the radius.
**** Works independently of Bone Guard's {{M|cooldown}}, and does not cost {{M|mana}}.
**** Does not proc on-cast effects.
*** This ability component consider {{M|clones}}, {{M|illusions}}, and {{M|creep-heroes}} as heroes.
*** Affects the following units:
**** {{M|Fogged units|x}}.
**** {{M|Invisible|x}} units.
**** {{M|Untargetable}} units.
*** Does not affect the following units:
**** {{M|Hidden}} units.
**** {{M|Invulnerable}} units.

data.name: npc_dota_hero_skeleton_king
data.bio_loc: For untold years, King Ostarion built a kingdom from the remains of his enemies. It was an obsessive's errand, done to pass the long eternities of a monarchy that seemed fated never to end. He believed that as long as he built up the towers of his palace, he could not die. But eventually he learned that he had been deluded... that bone itself could perish. Deeply mistrustful of flesh, he sought a more permanent way of extending his reign, and at last settled on pursuit of wraith energy, a form of pure spirit given off by certain dark souls at death. Should he infuse himself with Wraith Essence, he thought he might create a body as luminous and eternal as his ego. On the millennial solstice known as Wraith-Night, he submitted to a rite of transformation, compelling his subjects to harvest enough souls to fuel his ambition for immortality. No one knows how many of his champions died, for the only survivor who mattered was the Wraith King who rose with the sun on the following morn. Now he rarely spends a moment on his glowing throne--but strides out with sword drawn, demanding a fealty that extends far beyond death.
data.hype_loc: Striding fearlessly toward his enemies, Wraith King stuns his foes and slashes them into submission. Should his enemies gain the upper hand, his self-resurrecting ultimate ensures he'll have another chance to swing his sword.

abilities.name: skeleton_king_hellfire_blast
abilities.desc_loc: Wraith King sears an enemy unit with spectral fire, dealing damage and stunning, then dealing damage over time and slowing the target.
abilities.lore_loc: Ostarion calls on his damned lineage, laying waste to his opponents.

abilities.name: skeleton_king_bone_guard
abilities.desc_loc: Gains a Charge for every 2 creeps killed and 2 charges per hero killed. Activate to spend all charges, summoning skeletons that respawn once when killed. Skeletons benefit from Vampiric Spirit's lifesteal.
abilities.lore_loc: Wraith King's blade drains his enemy's essence to feed his aura.
notes_loc: Break disables the gaining of new stacks.
Casting Wraithfire Blast on an enemy causes the skeletons to attack that enemy.

abilities.name: skeleton_king_mortal_strike
abilities.desc_loc: Wraith King passively deals bonus damage on an attack with a cooldown.
abilities.lore_loc: One blow to crush a foe.
abilities.shard_loc: Mortal Strike hits curse their target, causing them to take %curse_damage_pct%%% of the initial attack damage again as <font color="#d8ae53">Pure</font> damage after a %curse_delay% second delay. Vampiric Spirit's lifesteal applies to the curse damage.

abilities.name: skeleton_king_vampiric_spirit
abilities.desc_loc: Grants Wraith King Lifesteal. When slain Wraith King turns into a free pathing Wraith with Bonus Attack and Movement Speed for a short duration, delaying his death. Wraith King cannot reincarnate after being a Wraith.
notes_loc: Credit for allies whose death was delayed will go to whoever struck the original killing blow.
Break only disables the passive lifesteal component.
Respawn timer is reduced by Wraith duration.
abilities.scepter_loc: Turns Vampiric Spirit into an aura, allowing allied heroes to turn into wraiths when slain. Extends wraith duration.

abilities.name: skeleton_king_reincarnation
abilities.desc_loc: Wraith King's form regroups after death, allowing him to resurrect when killed in battle.  Upon death, enemy units in a %slow_radius% radius are slowed. Skeletons spawn and attack each nearby enemy hero. Can be self-cast to kill Wraith King instantly.
abilities.lore_loc: Conspirators against the Wraith King wonder why he never stays dead.
notes_loc: Wraith King won't revive if he doesn't have enough mana.
If Wraith King has an Aegis and Reincarnation off cooldown, Reincarnation will trigger first.
Revives with full HP and Mana.
facets_loc: When reincarnating, %shard_skeleton_count% skeletons are spawned and attack each nearby enemy hero.
When reincarnating, nearby enemy heroes have their curse cooldowns reset.

talents.name: special_bonus_unique_wraith_king_4
talents.desc_loc: Instead of being slowed, all enemy units within 900 range have the current level of Wraithfire Blast cast on them when Reincarnation triggers.
